address: 57 Wirat Hong Yok 3 Road, Wichit, Mueang Phuket, Phuket, 83000, Thailand
bio: Customers with a sweet tooth and fans of deep-fried goodness line up here from 6am to get their daily fix. The deep-fried Patongko (dough sticks) and salapao are freshly prepared; the crunchy fries are golden-brown. It’s all very tasty; even without the dipping sauces....
